page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highcpu-90 is a high-density compute-focused instance powered by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provisions 90 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 45 physical cores with symmetric multithreading enabled. System resources include 177 GB of system memory, providing an allocation ratio of roughly 1.97 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include support for advanced vector instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16, alongside hardware cryptographic acceleration including AES and SHA extensions.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional multi-core computational throughput. The instance placed in the top tier on PassMark CPU tests, including extended instruction and encryption evaluations, while also posting top 10 percent scores on Geekbench clang software compilation and ray tracing. Multi-threaded decompression and multi-core stress-ng tests likewise registered in the top quartile. However, single-core benchmarks such as Geekbench single-core and gzip compression demonstrated average middle-range throughput, reflecting a profile centered around scale-out multi-threaded execution rather than peak single-threaded clock frequencies.

The memory subsystem exhibits solid read performance, achieving 215.31 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and strong cache-line bandwidth, though large-block write operations scale at average levels. The configuration contains no onboard local storage and includes no discrete graphics processing units or bundled IPv4 addresses. Storage relies completely on remote persistent disks, which should be factored into overall architecture design when planning data-heavy operations.

Given its balance of high core density and moderate per-core memory footprint, Google Cloud Platform c3d-highcpu-90 is cost-efficient for heavy parallelized computation that does not require massive per-thread memory pools. Primary fit workloads include continuous integration and distributed compilation pipelines, static web traffic handling, batch parallel computing, video or 3D rendering, and CPU-driven machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highcpu-90 is a high-density compute instance featuring 90 dedicated vCPUs across 45 physical AMD EPYC 9B14 cores on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 177 GB of RAM, the system delivers roughly 1.97 GB of memory per vCPU, optimized for parallel computing tasks rather than memory-heavy footprints. The instance includes AVX-512 vector support and hardware encryption acceleration, but provisions no bundled local storage or discrete GPUs. Across synthetic evaluations, the platform demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded processing, scoring in the top 10 percent on Clang compilation and PassMark encryption benchmarks, alongside strong throughput in Redis operations and static web serving. Moderate single-core execution speeds and average memory write throughput represent key architectural tradeoffs. The instance is tailored for distributed software compilation, parallel batch processing, high-concurrency web serving, and CPU-based inference workloads.
